fields.description: Issue features local political commentary and investigative reporting, including an editorial questioning the legality of newly installed parking meters at Miami International Airport and extensive coverage of Miami Beach city government conflicts involving City Manager Claude Renshaw and council authority. Reports on Miami municipal court cases alleging vice-raid abuses and police conduct at the Lenox Hotel, along with discussion of Florida state politics and taxation (opposition to a general sales tax) and references to proposed legalized gambling legislation. Additional items include a report on new furnished rental apartments coming to market in southwest Miami, notices and opinion digests from the Florida Attorney General, public information on 1950 driver license renewals, community announcements (Knights of Pythias Labor Day fish fry at Crandon Park), and entertainment/nightlife advertising and columns.
